quality.review_scope: Source-scoped preparation, characterization, sensing and computational evidence from the admitted eight-page main article and 26-page SI. Explicit source variants and contradictions are retained. Cited upstream papers are not admitted. Computational ZnS structures are models, not measured nanocrystal phases or coordinates.
missing_fields: Exact physical batch identifiers and unreported source settings remain unknown.
Absolute configuration of the lipoic-acid centre is not reported where that moiety is present; no surface-bound or 3D molecular geometry is inferred.
An exact molecular formula is not separately stated for this preparation; no graph-derived formula is presented as reported.
NMR sample concentration, acquisition temperature, pulse sequence and detailed scan settings are not reported.
Extraction volumes/portions, evaporation pressure and chromatography column/loading/flow are not reported.
conflicts: Main Fig 2(a) gives 65% for a combined route through compound 2, whereas SI separately reports compound 1 91% and compound 2 61%; the combined yield is not an isolated compound 1 yield. Sources: Main PDF p.3, Fig 2 caption; SI PDF pp.3-4, O,O-prime-Bis(2-azidoethyl)ethylene glycol (1); SI PDF p.4, compound 2.
